deals.comment: Yahoo Japan Corporation (TSE:4689) agreed to acquire CyberAgent FX Inc. from CyberAgent Inc. (TSE:4751) for approximately ¥21 billion on December 12, 2012. Yahoo Japan will acquire 0.02 shares representing 100% stake in CyberAgent FX. For the year ended March 31, 2012, CyberAgent FX posted net assets of ¥9.07 billion, total assets of ¥65.99 billion, revenue of ¥8.5 billion, operating income of ¥4.02 billion, ordinary income of ¥3.92 biliion, and net income of ¥2.29 billion. Board of Directors of CyberAgent Inc. resolved the transaction on December 12, 2012. The transaction is subject to approval from authorities. The transaction is expected to close on January 1, 2013. On January 31, 2013, all shares of CyberAgent FX will be transferred. CyberAgent Inc. expects to receive gain of ¥10 billion from the sale.

Yahoo Japan Corporation (TSE:4689) signed a contract to acquire KC Co., Ltd. from KC Card Co., Ltd. for ¥22.7 billion on June 25, 2014. Through an absorption-type corporate split, KC Card Co., Ltd will first spin out a portion of its operations related mainly to the brand name of KC Card, into a newly established company named KC Co., Ltd. Yahoo Japan Corporation will then acquire all the 1300 shares of KC Co., Ltd. For the year ending December 31, 2013, the acquired operations reported total assets of ¥66.23 billion, net assets of ¥47.85 billion, operating revenue of ¥9.71 billion, operating income of ¥3.65 billion, net income of ¥3.85 billion. Yahoo Japan will incur ¥70 million in advisor fees on the purchase. The transaction is expected to be closed by January 5, 2015. The impact of the purchase on Yahoo Japan's consolidated and non-consolidated performances for the fiscal year ending March 2015 is expected to be minor. Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley Securities Co., Ltd. acted as financial advisor for Yahoo Japan.

Yahoo Japan Corporation (TSE:4689) signed an agreement to acquire 33.4% of Astmax Asset Management, Inc. from ASTMAX Co., Ltd. (JASDAQ:7162) for ¥1.7 billion on August 8, 2016. Yahoo Japan will acquire 23,757 shares. The transaction is expected to complete on October 3, 2016.

Yahoo Japan Corporation (TSE:4689) agreed to acquire additional 16.7% stake in Astmax Asset Management, Inc. from ASTMAX Co., Ltd. (JASDAQ:7162) for approximately ¥850 million on March 13, 2019. Under the terms of the transaction, Yahoo Japan Corporation will acquire 0.012 million shares of Astmax Asset Management, Inc for ¥71700 per share. Post completion of the transaction, Yahoo Japan Corporation will hold 50.1% stake in Astmax Asset Management, Inc. As of March 31, 2018, Astmax Asset Management, Inc. reported net assets of ¥793 million, revenue of ¥2.01 billion, total assets ¥1.14 billion, operating profit of ¥221 million and net income of ¥152 million. The transaction is expected to complete on April 1, 2019.
